data.description: 老旧公寓高层露台窗台，远处夜空中依稀绽放着夏日祭典的绚烂花火。侧坐在窗台上，单手拉着脖颈上的黑项圈，紫黑短发随风轻拂，咬着下唇露出顽皮而危险的笑容，眼神勾魂摄魄。 她微微抬眸轻语——“电次君……真的要逃跑吗？乡村的老鼠和城市的老鼠……今晚，你只想落入哪一只的陷阱里呢？”
data.promptProse: Perched sideways on the open windowsill of an old high-rise apartment as summer festival fireworks bloom overhead, Reze wears a smoky-violet sheer floral-lace cropped bralette, cheeky briefs, and her signature black velvet choker. Tugging lightly at the collar while biting her lip in a teasing, wistful smile, she catches colorful bursts of firework light.
data.animaCaption: Perched sideways on an open apartment windowsill in a smoky-violet sheer floral-lace bralette and briefs, she tugs lightly at her black velvet pin choker while biting her lower lip with a playful, bittersweet smile. Bursting summer festival fireworks wash colorful light across the night sky.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a smoky-violet sheer floral-lace cropped bralette and low-rise cheeky briefs paired with her black velvet pin-ring choker.
